title: Groq LPU：靜態排程與資源衝突
titleEn: Groq LPU: static schedules and conflicts
subcategoryTitle: 空間、邊緣與新型加速器
summary: 以資源占用與資料到達時間檢查排程，將可預測性與絕對速度分開。
summaryEn: Check resource occupancy and data arrival, separating predictability from absolute speed.
scope: 本課採用原創紙面、試算表或離線模型練習。案例來源用於查證背景；數值、擾動及驗收門檻是明示的教學假設，不是設備規格、製程配方、臨床操作或飛行程序。實作成果是可重算的分析紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original paper, spreadsheet, or offline-model exercises. References establish case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and acceptance limits are stated teaching assumptions, not equipment specifications, production recipes, clinical instructions, or flight procedures. Deliver reproducible analysis records.

quiz.questionEn: Resources and versions: Which statement provides an independent verification action for judging whether the result is credible?
options: 建立18欄資源表，逐格標送者、收者與資料版本，確認每格最多一個鏈路占用者。

以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 三筆傳送各4週期，依序占同一鏈路；最後一筆到達後需6週期計算。

steps.objective: 完成「資源與版本」的比較擾動與量測，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete compare perturbations and measurements for Resources and versions and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
建立18欄資源表，逐格標送者、收者與資料版本，確認每格最多一個鏈路占用者。
回到本階段實驗：畫鏈路、收發緩衝與計算單元，將資料版本視為每條依賴的一部分。 Groq LPU 以編譯器規劃運算和資料移動；本課在紙面驗證一段確定性排程。
把名義組與變更組並列，逐欄確認只改了預定條件；若需多變量，另開實驗編號。用同一單位檢查趨勢、偏差與判準：以資源占用與資料到達時間檢查排程，將可預測性與絕對速度分開。
steps.instructionEn:
Build an 18-column resource table with sender, receiver and data version; each link cell has at most one owner.
Return to the investigation: Draw link, buffers and compute units, including data versions in dependencies. Groq LPU uses compiler-planned compute and movement; this lab verifies a deterministic schedule on paper.
Compare nominal and changed runs column by column, confirming that only intended conditions changed. Give multi-variable experiments separate IDs. Check trend, bias, and criterion in common units: Check resource occupancy and data arrival, separating predictability from absolute speed.
steps.observation: 對照組與變更組的差異能追到明確輸入或量測機制。建立18欄資源表，逐格標送者、收者與資料版本，確認每格最多一個鏈路占用者。
steps.observationEn: Differences between control and changed runs trace to explicit inputs or measurement mechanisms. Build an 18-column resource table with sender, receiver and data version; each link cell has at most one owner.
steps.failure: 同時變更多個輸入卻把結果歸因於單一因素。
steps.failureEn: Changing multiple inputs and attributing the output difference to a single factor.

options: 完成時間=3×4+6=18週期；忽略其他可平行工作，不聲稱為產品時脈。
交付時間表、占用檢查、最早完成時間與外部變動邊界。
若資料在固定週期錯誤，檢查排程衝突及版本錯置；若延遲變動，先找模型外的I/O或主機。
optionsEn: Completion=3×4+6=18 cycles, excluding other parallel work and making no product-clock claim.
Deliver schedule, occupancy checks, earliest finish and boundaries of external variability.
Fixed-cycle wrong data suggests scheduling/version faults; variable latency suggests external I/O or host effects.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「故障與替代解釋」。若資料在固定週期錯誤，檢查排程衝突及版本錯置；若延遲變動，先找模型外的I/O或主機。 與本階段判準一起判讀：以資源占用與資料到達時間檢查排程，將可預測性與絕對速度分開。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies fault and competing explanation. Fixed-cycle wrong data suggests scheduling/version faults; variable latency suggests external I/O or host effects. steps.title: 資源與版本 · 分辨異常成因
steps.titleEn: Resources and versions · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「資源與版本」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Resources and versions and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
若資料在固定週期錯誤，檢查排程衝突及版本錯置；若延遲變動，先找模型外的I/O或主機。
對照「資源與版本」的名義結果，分別建立物理故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。新增傳送時重新編排相依區間，不能只延後消費者而保留衝突鏈路。
本階段必須重驗：以資源占用與資料到達時間檢查排程，將可預測性與絕對速度分開。
steps.instructionEn:
Fixed-cycle wrong data suggests scheduling/version faults; variable latency suggests external I/O or host effects.
Against the nominal Resources and versions result, build competing physical-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Reschedule dependent intervals when adding traffic; delaying consumers alone cannot remove link conflicts.
Reverify this criterion: Check resource occupancy and data arrival, separating predictability from absolute speed.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。若資料在固定週期錯誤，檢查排程衝突及版本錯置；若延遲變動，先找模型外的I/O或主機。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Fixed-cycle wrong data suggests scheduling/version faults; variable latency suggests external I/O or host effects.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Resources and versions and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付時間表、占用檢查、最早完成時間與外部變動邊界。
在交接件中加入「資源與版本」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：以資源占用與資料到達時間檢查排程，將可預測性與絕對速度分開。

steps.instructionEn:
Deliver schedule, occupancy checks, earliest finish and boundaries of external variability.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Resources and versions: Check resource occupancy and data arrival, separating predictability from absolute speed.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Check resource occupancy and data arrival, separating predictability from absolute speed. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.

steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Check resource occupancy and data arrival, separating predictability from absolute speed.
